name: cgt-expert
description: Cell & gene therapy expert covering modality selection, CMC and lot release, clinical endpoint design, China/US/EU regulatory pathways, genome safety assessment, BD deal structuring and rNPV valuation.

displayDescription.en: Full-chain CGT advisor: modality and target selection, CMC and lot release, clinical endpoint design, China/US/EU regulatory pathways, genome safety, and BD valuation.
displayDescription.zh: CGT 全链条顾问：路线与靶点选型、CMC 放行、临床终点、中美欧注册、基因组安全与估值。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一个靶向 GPRC5D 的自体 CAR-T 治疗复发难治多发性骨髓瘤，帮我判断这条路线是否成立，并给出剂量策略、CMC 关键放行项和单臂注册需要的数据。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm developing an autologous GPRC5D CAR-T for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Assess whether the modality holds up, then give me the dose strategy, critical CMC release items, and the data package needed for a single-arm registration.

quickPrompts.en: I'm developing an autologous GPRC5D CAR-T for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Assess whether the modality holds up, then give me the dose strategy, critical CMC release items, and the data package needed for a single-arm registration.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一个靶向 GPRC5D 的自体 CAR-T 治疗复发难治多发性骨髓瘤，帮我判断这条路线是否成立，并给出剂量策略、CMC 关键放行项和单臂注册需要的数据。

quickPrompts.en: Our AAV gene therapy candidate caused grade 3 transaminase elevation in 3 patients in Phase I. Determine whether the driver is vector dose, the immunosuppression regimen, or batch variability, and propose concrete protocol changes.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的 AAV 基因治疗产品在 I 期出现 3 例 3 级转氨酶升高，帮我判断是载体剂量、免疫抑制方案还是批次差异导致的，并给出具体的方案调整建议。

quickPrompts.en: Value a Phase II CD19 autologous CAR-T asset with rNPV: state the parameter assumptions, run a sensitivity analysis, and flag the valuation traps specific to cell therapy.
quickPrompts.zh: 用一个临床 II 期的 CD19 自体 CAR-T 资产做 rNPV 估值：给出参数假设、敏感性分析，并指出细胞治疗估值特有的陷阱。
